# Film and Video Lighting

> > Professional film and video lighting equipment, grip gear, power distribution, and production accessories from industry-leading brands including Arri, American Grip, Matthews Studio Equipment, and Aputure.

Film and Video Lighting (BarnDoor Lighting) is a specialized retailer serving the film and video production industry with comprehensive grip equipment, lighting modifiers, power distribution systems, and camera support solutions. The site offers professional-grade products from manufacturers like Arri, American Grip, Matthews, Astera, and Chauvet for cinematographers, gaffers, and production crews.

## Key Topics

- Grip Equipment
- Lighting Accessories
- American Grip
- Film Production Gear
- Power Distribution
- Lighting Control
- Diffusion & Modifiers
- Camera Support
- Arri Lighting
- Matthews Studio Equipment
- Overhead Frames & Fabrics
- Stage Pin Connectors
- Grip Stands
- Aputure
- Astera LED
